purpose: Check whether the upload parser preserves selected inventory-planning instructions on two image-heavy pages from an official Amazon Seller Central guide.
reference_method: Each phrase was visually checked against the rendered source page. This is not a full-page transcription or independent adjudication.
limitations: The 2020 Amazon FBA guide is an attributed platform example, not policy for the synthetic Commerce dataset or another retailer.
The selected pages have a partial text layer and embedded imagery; they are not physical scans.
Phrase-anchor recall does not measure CER/WER, reading order, structured table extraction, or decision-answer quality.
The sampled phrases are selected and do not represent every visible label or quantity on either page.
